title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am a PhD Student in a reputed research institute from India. The sole niyyat of my doing PhD is daawat/tashkeel/kasb-e-halaal in the institute. Once in 6 months I need to go in a conference and present a paper in a conference hall or auditorium. I have a beard with fist length and I am always in long loose kurta and shalwar above ankles. When I am on the stage, the photographers treat me similar to all the audience and take a photo/video of mine or they take my photo whenever I ask questions during the discussion. They do this for non-muslims too. I totally dislike that someone take my photo, because thats haraam as per my knowledge. So my respected muftyaan-e-ikraam is it permissible for a practising muslim to wear a thin helmet (with face cover) and goto such places? If the audience laugh seeing a practising Muslim in helmet, is then wearing the helmet permissible in shariat? I feel my niyaat of daawat/tashkeel and my muaamlaat demand that I should go there but shariat prohibits photography so how shall I maintain taqwa in this issue? Is the question clear ? Hoping for an earliest reply. 2390 views Q. Is it allowed for men to wear gold plated watches, which are not made of 100% gold? 5097 views Q. Every year I give foods to the underprivileged on Muharram for my elders who are not alive with niyat. Is this a bida’h? 3320 views Q. I am working in Vodafone company. As a frontliner I have to do shave every day, because it is mandatory in our company to shave every day. And I accepted to do shave everyday for my job. Is my salary halal? 3332 views Q. Aswk Mufti Saab, I am from Bangalore-india and am 25 yrs of age and a great great fan of Maulana Tariq Jameel saheb and Maulana Anzar shah Qasmi. Because of the mercy of Allah and influence of above people i have decided to dedicate rest of my life in Dawa and Tableeque. I have few confusion\questions for you. 1.I work for American based company(MNC) and want to know if my earnings from American company is Halaal\Haraam.At this scenario of the world, can Momin work under American companies? 2.I work in a mixed environment(Men and Women), whats shariah ruling on this? 3.Few days back, before FAJR, i saw a dream where a man wearing Turban(white), having one fist beard sitting opposite to me and telling me laughing....what you will do in Tableeq, what talent you have to do Tabliq? Why do you want to offer rest of your life to Dawa and Tablique? Please help me with above questions and please pray that i spend rest of my life in the path of Allah(swt) May Allah guide us!!! 3847 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 25839 Country: India Title: It has been 30 or 35 years since i am married and we have no child. but we have adopted a son of my brother-in law. we have adopted him soon after his birth even he did not taste his mother's milk. we had done all the legal formalities. we have legally given him our property. the question is now he is young and ready to marry so we want to know that in NIKAH documents whose name should be written his real mother and father' name or who have adopted him. please enlighten me on this through the light of QURAN and HADIS. Question: It has been 30 or 35 years since i am married and we have no child. but we have adopted a son of my brother-in law. we have adopted him soon after his birth even he did not taste his mother's milk. we had done all the legal formalities. we have legally given him our property. the question is now he is young and ready to marry so we want to know that in NIKAH documents whose name should be written his real mother and father' name or who have adopted him. please enlighten me on this through the light of QURAN and HADIS. AL MUSTAFI MOHAMMAD MUSTAFA KASMI, IMAM-O-KHATIB, MAKKI MASZID, ISLAM NAGAR, GHAZIABAD,U.P.-201001. Answer ID: 25839 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2116/H=619/th=1431) The name of real father shall be written in the column of father's name not the person who has adopted the child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
